subject: Finovix trial tempo and governance checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <akim@finovix.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovix.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finovix — post-call recap & proposed tempo for evaluation

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed, lightweight governance cadence to ensure the POC validates the three top success criteria you called out: accuracy on customer-derived prompts, <20% latency tail at 99th percentile, and no PII exfiltration on filtered datasets.

Scope (short): small-scale trial connecting a subset of your anonymized support transcripts to Redwood hosted sandbox. Deliverables: integration guide + sandbox access (Redwood), weekly evaluation readouts, acceptance report at final readout.

Proposed milestone calendar (draft):
- Kickoff & sandbox access: week of Aug 10 (pref. Aug 10 or 11)
- Week 1 (Aug 10–17): integration + sample ingestion, smoke tests
- Week 2 (Aug 17–24): model runs + latency/cost profiling, interim readout
- Week 3 (Aug 24–31): iterate prompts & guardrails, prep acceptance dataset
- Final readout & acceptance decision: week of Sep 14 (final presentations + acceptance criteria review)

Owners (draft):
- Redwood: Logan (sandbox, model config), Irene (success criteria checklist, ops), Jordan (milestones, commercial).
- Finovix: Alex (data owner), Priya (security/compliance contact).

Immediate asks for kickoff prep:
1) A sample of the support transcript schema (JSON/CSV) — redacted or anonymized.
2) A test SSO account or a short-lived API key for sandbox connectivity.
3) Confirmation if SOC 2 evidence or an initial security questionnaire will be required prior to sandbox access (we can share SOC 2 Type II reports).

Attachments: finovix_trial_agenda.pdf (agenda + roles), finovix_milestones.xlsx (calendar + gating criteria).

If that tempo looks reasonable, I’ll schedule the kickoff and lock the calendar. If you need to shift the kickoff week, tell me your earliest available dates and we’ll adapt.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0103
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <akim@finovix.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovix.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finovix — post-call recap & proposed tempo for evaluation

Jordan — quick tech notes I want to surface before kickoff so Alex/Priya know what to expect.

- Sandbox config: we’ll spin a dedicated sandbox instance with a quantized 8-bit variant of the model you preferred (cost-friendly). We’ll provide an ephemeral API key and guided instructions for streaming and KV cache testing.
- Data ingestion: small ingestion (up to 10k records) should be fine for the initial run; please send sample schema. We’ll redact at rest and only pull what’s required for the trial runs.
- Latency profiling: initial baseline will be with 8k token context; tail latency can improve with prefix caching — we’ll test both.
- Cost estimate: rough estimate for the 3-week run is ~1.2M tokens -> we’ll provide a more precise estimate once we see the sample volume.

I’ll prepare a short checklist for the kickoff that covers: firewall/egress rules, API key exchange, expected dataset shapes, and a SOC2 pointer pack. Jordan — I’ll attach the checklist to the invite and be ready to demo the sandbox setup on day 1.

—Logan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Kim <akim@finovix.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovix.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 02:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Finovix — post-call recap & proposed tempo for evaluation

Thanks Jordan and Logan — useful recap. Two quick asks from our side before you spin anything up: 

1) Can we shift the kickoff to Aug 12 (we have an internal roadmap review on Aug 10–11 that blocks most stakeholders)?
2) For SOC2 evidence: we will need to see a redacted SOC2 Type II report and a short answers doc that maps Redwood controls to our data handling checklist. If you have a standard SOC2 pointer pack, please attach.

Also, Priya and I discussed whether we can limit the initial sample to non-PII tickets only — we can produce a 2k-record extract that’s already filtered. That should make the security checklist easier.

If Aug 12 works for you, let’s lock in the meeting and we’ll send the filtered extract before the kickoff.

—Alex
Head of Data Product | Finovix

2) Logan: prepare sandbox image, ephemeral API key, and kickoff checklist (firewall rules, ingestion steps). Deliverable: sandbox-ready by Aug 11.

4) Finovix (Alex/Priya): provide the 2k non-PII extract and confirmation of who will attend from security (for the SOC2 Q&A).
